lines.trans: Our restaurant always remains the best in Moscow.
A team of professional chefs works here.
There are always products of the highest quality here.
Our guest service is at the highest level.
Excuse me, a waiter will come to you soon.
We are not in much of a hurry today.
There are very many orders in the dining room today.
We understand everything perfectly.
Of course, our restaurant needs a good owner.
The owner must be strong and confident.
He always knows exactly what to do.
I put everything into that safe!
